| LDO | 0.3 | 47 TMT (Aug 2026) | -41.8% | null | -40.3% | Major Decontrolled Product Aug 2026 |

| Others (Sulfur, Propylene, etc.) | 4.2 | 777 TMT (Aug 2026) | -5.0% | null | -22.8% | Other Minor Decontrolled Products |
| Total Natural Gas Consumption | null | 5,708 MMSCM (Aug 2026) | -2.39% | null | null | Total Natural Gas Consumption (including internal) |

### 3. EMPIRICAL OBSERVATIONS & DIVERGENCE
- **Top Growth Drivers:** Bitumen (+20.0% YoY), SKO (+17.2% YoY), Lubricants & Greases (+11.6% YoY), FO/LSHS (+4.9% YoY), MS (+8.2% YoY), HSD (+6.8% YoY), ATF (+2.1% YoY)
- **Key Drags & Contractions:** LDO (-41.8% YoY), Petcoke (-28.6% YoY), Naphtha (-22.3% YoY), LPG (-17.1% YoY), Others (-5.0% YoY)
- **Infrastructure Momentum:** Total cargo handled at major ports reached 77,409 TMT in Aug 2026 (8.44% YoY growth); total e-way bills generated reached 1,390.88 lakhs in Aug 2026 (8% YoY growth); total commercial vehicle sales reached 90,769 units (14.5% YoY growth); tractor sales reached 87,977 units (0.8% YoY growth).

### 4. MACROECONOMIC AUDIT VERDICT
- **Institutional Activity Signal:** CONTRACTION
- **Empirical Thesis:** Total petroleum products consumption contracted by 2.8% YoY to 18.61 MMT in August 2026, driven by significant double-digit de-growth in LDO, petcoke, naphtha, and LPG. Despite robust retail transport demand boosting petrol (MS) and diesel (HSD) consumption, the aggregate figures reflect a broader contraction across industrial and sensitive product categories.
